verdict.rationale: Adyen Issuing exposes an extensive documented public API covering card creation, authorization webhooks, transaction rules, dispute handling, and payment instrument management, all reachable via /paymentInstruments and webhook endpoints described in docs. An llms.txt endpoint confirms structured developer documentation is served, though probes show no discoverable OpenAPI/Swagger spec. Missing for 10: a publicly discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec, and independent third-party corroboration of API usability.
